items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 117:1
items.html: At the time when the coupling Malchut ascended from the place of the mouth to the openings of the eyes, the coupling was made there, and the light came out through the openings of the eyes and not through the mouth. (Item 6).
